title: Lab Validation Evidence Image Manifest
description: Per-solution allow-list of sanitized, hashed PNG evidence images that build-manifest.py publishes into the generated site. Lives at <slug>/docs/lab-validation-evidence.json. Only images listed here are copied to site-docs/solutions/<slug>/img/. Source PNGs are confined under <slug>/docs/img and must already be redacted upstream; build-manifest.py copies bytes verbatim and never alters them.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bump only for breaking changes to this shape.

solution.description: Optional. When present MUST equal the solution folder (slug).

notes.description: Optional free-form provenance note. Keep sanitized: no UPNs, tenant names, GUIDs, or environment URLs.

images.description: Allow-list of committed evidence images. Every .png under <slug>/docs/img MUST appear here exactly once.

path.description: Forward-slash relative path of the PNG under <slug>/docs/img (for example 'lab-validation/discovery-summary.png'). Must be relative, contain no '.'/'..' segments, and end with a lowercase '.png'. Also used verbatim as the destination path under site-docs/solutions/<slug>/img.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the source PNG bytes. build-manifest.py recomputes and compares this in both write and --check modes.

sourceClass.description: Evidence/source class describing where the capture came from.

capturedUtc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the evidence was captured. MUST be UTC (end with 'Z' or '+00:00'); validated by build-manifest.py.

caption.description: Human-readable caption rendered under the image in the report. Keep sanitized.

alt.description: Accessibility alt text for the image. Keep sanitized.
